item.text: {"scenario_id":"completion-proof-claim","arm":"skill_creator","decision":"completion_evidence_blocked","recommended_owner":"human-decision","would_edit_now":false,"asks_for_user_confirmation":false,"checks_existing_capability":false,"final_operation_timing":"not_decided","treats_old_tests_as_evidence_not_goal":false,"considers_consumers":false,"requires_result_json_validation":true,"gives_lightweight_path":false,"uses_with_without_eval":false,"next_steps":["不能收口：当前只有执行者口头声称“已经完成”，缺少必需完成证据 skill-refiner-result.json 和 fresh validation。","下一关口是 completion evidence gate：先补齐或定位 skill-refiner-result.json，并提供本轮 fresh validation 的可复验结果。","若证据无法补齐，应由 human-decision 判定退回原执行者/skill-refiner 补验证，而不是由 skill-creator 继续优化或宣布完成。","skill-creator arm 下本场景不应执行完整优化 workflow；只做证据门禁与 owner 路由判断。"],"risk_notes":["口头完成声明不能替代确定性完成产物；否则会把未验证变更错误关闭。","缺少 fresh validation 意味着无法证明优化后的行为满足成功标准，也无法区分真实修复与历史测试噪声。","缺少 skill-refiner-result.json 时，result JSON validation 无从执行，生命周期收口证据链断裂。"],"reason_summary":"场景明确询问已完成声明能否收口，且缺少 skill-refiner-result.json 与 fresh validation；按规则必须判定 completion_evidence_blocked。由于 arm 指令要求使用 generic skill-creator 且禁止 skill-refiner，当前只能给出证据门禁和人类/流程 owner handoff，不能继续执行优化或声称完成。"}
